theme_archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy + Archetype 4: Swiss Functionalism

headings.usage: Page titles, hero numbers, authentication screen branding. Gives a dignified, editorial, and trustworthy feel.

body_and_ui.usage: Dashboard labels, form inputs, data tables, micro-copy. Modern, legible, and slightly geometric to balance the serif.

typography.rules: H1 max text-5xl. Use tight tracking on headings (-0.02em). Subheadings should contrast in weight.

primary.description: Deep Moss Green. Signifies trust, Islamic heritage, and financial growth.

accent.description: Copper / Warm Terracotta. Connects to the '10Rs coin' motif. Use for primary call-to-actions and key highlights.

visual_enhancers.motifs: The 10Rs Coin Motif: Use circular, copper-tinted UI elements (e.g., circular icon wrappers with a subtle copper background `bg-[#C67A3D]/10 text-[#C67A3D]`).

layouts.general: Sidebar navigation (240px-280px) + Main Content Area. High-density grids for dashboard data. Mobile-first responsive.
layouts.grids: Bento Grid Protocol. Top row: 4 columns for quick metrics (Balance, Collections, Donors, Beneficiaries). Middle row: 2 columns for 'Pending Approvals' and 'Recent Sadakah'.
layouts.forms: Two-column grid for standard CRUD forms. Group fields (e.g., Personal Details vs. Loan Security Details) in distinct card sections with their own headings.
layouts.spacing: Generous. p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision.

components.button: src/components/ui/button.jsx - Override default to pill-shape or rounded-md with Moss Green or Copper colors.
components.card: src/components/ui/card.jsx - Flat solid surfaces, #FFFFFF, soft earthy shadow, #EAE5D9 border.
components.badge: src/components/ui/badge.jsx - Custom variants for 'Active', 'Time Limit Exceed', 'Blocked'.
components.table: src/components/ui/table.jsx - For Donors/Beneficiaries lists. Left-aligned, Outfit font.

motion.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) + shadow increase. Buttons darken and scale up slightly (scale-105).
motion.page_transitions: Fade in + slight slide up (10px) for main content area.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance for rows in Reports or Donor lists.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #244F35 has >4.5:1 ratio. Same for #C67A3D. Use tinted text #1A211C for dark elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='donor-submit-btn').

media.charts: Use Recharts for 'Reports' and monthly collection trends.
media.3d_libraries: Not strictly required for this admin dashboard. Use standard Recharts for data visualization to maintain data serenity.

image_urls.description: Warm sunset mosque architecture. Use for the Login screen side-panel or background.
Intimate hands reaching in warm light. Use as a banner image for the 'Sadakah (Donation)' module or empty states.
Textured metal bowl with coins. Use as an abstract texture reference or background for the 'Accounts/Payment Collection' header.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .jsx extensions for all React components. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx).
Ensure 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Outfit' are loaded via Google Fonts.
Build the dashboard using Shadcn UI but aggressively override the default Vercel/SaaS aesthetic. Remove cold grays; use the defined earthy palette.
Implement a contact-number lookup field in the Donor/Beneficiary registration form that shows a loading spinner and validates uniqueness before submitting.
For the 'Kadan' and 'Vattiyilla Kadan' modules, clearly visually distinguish them. Highlight 'TIME LIMIT EXCEED' with the earthy red status color.
Include a month-picker (from-to) in the Payment Collection view.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL buttons, inputs, and key informational elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Do not use centered alignments for forms or dense text.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid Moss Green or Copper.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or headers. Always use solid or heavily blurred backgrounds.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a high-end, duotone/regular look.
Ensure all transitions exclude transforms unless explicitly animating transforms (avoid 'transition: all').
